column1: # WSDL 1.1 and 2.0 counters (.wsdl): the counters of xml-facts, its [ignore] line included (an
# embedded XML Schema counts there, under "XSD type definitions"), then one per WSDL element, without
# a prefix or with wsdl: or wsdl2:, so the soap:binding and soap:operation of a binding count only
# under "SOAP bindings". "operations" counts every <operation> of a portType, an interface and a
# binding, so an operation bound once counts twice. EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
